keyword: silver capital gains tax how it works in the US
angle: Physical silver is usually taxed under federal capital gains rules, but long-term gains can fall under the collectibles maximum rate rather than the standard long-term stock rate.

stats.claim: Net capital gains from selling collectibles such as coins or art are taxed at a maximum 28% rate.
Collectibles gain or loss includes gain or loss from the sale or trade of metal such as gold, silver, and platinum bullion held more than 1 year.
The basis of property you buy is usually its cost.
Use Form 8949 to report sales and exchanges of capital assets, then carry the subtotals to Schedule D.
